name: mask skips exactly one handler and restores normal scope
source: handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(100) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(1) }, (_) -> { let a = mask Ping((_) -> { perform Ping({}) }) let b = perform Ping({}) !int_add(a, b) }) })

name: nested masks skip two handlers
source: handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(100) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(10) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(1) }, (_) -> { mask Ping((_) -> { mask Ping((_) -> { perform Ping({}) }) }) }) }) })

name: handlers installed inside mask remain active
source: handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(1) }, (_) -> { mask Ping((_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(42) }, (_) -> { perform Ping({}) }) }) })

name: mask survives repeated operations and multi-shot resumption
source: handle Choose((_, k) -> { !int_add(k(1), k(2)) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(10) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(1) }, (_) -> { mask Ping((_) -> { let n = perform Choose({}) let a = perform Ping({}) let b = perform Ping({}) !int_add(n, !int_add(a, b)) }) }) }) })

name: skipped and selected handlers have independent request and reply types
source: handle Ping((text, k) -> { k(!string_length(text)) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((n, k) -> { k(!int_to_string(n)) }, (_) -> { let text = perform Ping(42) mask Ping((_) -> { perform Ping(text) }) }) })

name: mask separates function reply effects from private State
source: handle Log((n, k) -> { k(!int_add(n, 1)) }, (_) -> { handle State((_, k) -> { k((n) -> { perform Log(n) }) }, (_) -> { let f = perform State({}) mask State((_) -> { f(41) }) }) })

name: mask can be passed as a first-class value
source: let outside = mask Ping handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(42) }, (_) -> { handle Ping((_, k) -> { k(0) }, (_) -> { outside((_) -> { perform Ping({}) }) }) })

name: pure allows internally handled effects
source: !pure((n) -> { handle Ping((value, k) -> { k(!int_add(value, 1)) }, (_) -> { perform Ping(n) }) })(41)

name: pure guards one application, not returned functions
source: handle Ping((n, k) -> { k(!int_add(n, 1)) }, (_) -> { let f = !pure((_) -> { (n) -> { perform Ping(n) } }) let g = f({}) g(41) })

name: obtaining a pure function may perform effects
